description: Inkling 2 Mini (thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, 26.4B total and 3.4B active looped mixture of experts; NVFP4 experts in layers 0-19, MXFP8 in 20-23) on one DGX Spark through TensorFold's Zig engine (tensorfold-native) as MiaAI-Lab's kit 6061fa89 builds it: Jürgen Schmied's Inkling 2 Mini CUDA engine (TensorFold PR #4441, commit dc2ca8a1) plus her patches 0001 to 0017 (CUDA DSpark drafting from the checkpoint's own mtp.safetensors, fp8 KV cache, the Inkling reply, reasoning and tool parser, structured output and tool_choice, native CUDA vision for PNG, JPEG and WebP images, prefill tensor cores). The creator publishes no image, so this recipe builds the kit's own image (Zig 0.17.0, xgrammar v0.2.8, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, libwebp 1.6.0 on NVIDIA's PyTorch 26.07 container) and scans the build for sm_121 kernels. Eight streams, a 262,144-token window, fp8 KV (lossy; bf16 is exact), DSpark drafts, image input, fp8 attention projections and tensor-core prefill (both lossy and on in the kit), replies of up to 32,768 tokens without max_tokens, and thinking on by default (the model reasons even at the lowest effort; reasoning_effort is chosen per request). Memory: the creator's engine total is about 59.7 GiB (17.6 GiB target, 1.54 GiB drafter and 0.59 GiB vision weights, 44.5 GiB for eight fp8 windows) plus the prompt cache, which the engine sizes at half the room left over a 16 GiB floor and measured at 16.0 GiB on an idle Spark, so the declared peak is 75.7 GiB; the engine keeps 9 GiB free when it sizes the pool. Predicted outcome: it fits an idle Spark with room to spare, but the creator's start check asks for about 86 GiB of MemAvailable at the start, so nothing large should share the Spark. The creator marks that start check, and the settings that follow the engine build, as PROVISIONAL until re-measured; the creator's memory and speed figures are claims until measured here. Licences (information only): the checkpoint is Apache-2.0 with Thinking Machines' Model Acceptable Use Policy; the kit is Apache-2.0 and TensorFold is MIT; the image carries NVIDIA's container terms and the licences of xgrammar, libjpeg-turbo and libwebp.
title: Inkling 2 Mini TensorFold single Spark (Mia)
